about: Where the voice-model download lives, per platform: one rule, shared by the sidecar and the desktop shell. sidecar/local-voice.js voiceCacheRoots must resolve `root` and `legacy` for every case (test/local-voice-cache-root.test.js), and src-tauri/src/erase_all.rs voice_model_cache_roots must return the same paths, `root` first, so ERASE EVERYTHING deletes both (test/native-process-ownership/tests/voice_cache_roots.rs). `root` is where a model lands now. `legacy` is where an older build left it, null where nothing moved. `node` is process.platform and `rust` is std::env::consts::OS. `env` is the whole environment a case runs with; the home folder is USERPROFILE on Windows and HOME elsewhere. Paths use forward slashes on every host: the JS test joins with path.posix and Rust compares parsed paths.

cases.name: the NSIS per-user layout: the install folder is LOCALAPPDATA/StarNet, so the legacy root sits inside it
Windows with no LOCALAPPDATA falls back to the user profile's own local folder
an empty LOCALAPPDATA counts as unset
macOS: the app's own folder, not a second one beside it
Linux keeps its cache folder, which was never inside an install folder
